$comment: Lookup map: code -> human-readable remediation for the lead. Keys MUST match the `code` field emitted by .overstory/claude-profiles/<profile>/hooks/probes/contract-flows/errors.ts. probe-run-with-ownership-check.sh reads this file and includes the matched entry in the auto-mail body so the lead gets actionable instructions per error code. Add a new entry when the loader gains a new code; no shell or wrapper code needs to change.
FLOW_FILE_MISSING_OWNS_OR_EXTENDS:
Decide ownership for each unbound declaration:
  (a) If THIS task owns the resource/actor: add `{ "resource": "<name>" }` (or `{ "actor": "<name>" }`) to the top-level `owns: [ ... ]` array.
  (b) If ANOTHER task already owns it (e.g. team is owned by sfx-webapp-boilerplate-362b): add it to `extends: [ ... ]` AND **delete the local `resources: [{ name: "<name>", ... }]` entry** for that resource. The loader rejects a file that simultaneously extends and redeclares the same resource. Use the extending file purely as a reference.
FLOW_MERGE_CONFLICT: Two flow files disagree on the same resource/actor definition. The diagnostic lists both files. Pick the canonical version (usually the file that OWNS the resource via owns[]), then delete the duplicate-with-divergence from the other file.
FLOW_DUPLICATE_ID: Two special_flows share the same id across files. Rename one of them. Prefer the rename in the newer/derived file so historical task references stay stable.
FLOW_TASK_ID_MISMATCH: The filename declares one task_id but the JSON body declares a different one. Either rename the file to match `task_id` or change `task_id` to match the filename.
FLOW_COVERAGE_TEMPLATE_UNKNOWN: A flow references a coverageTemplate that isn't registered with the probe runner. Pick a known template from the list the diagnostic prints, or have the orchestrator team register the new template before authoring flows that use it.
FLOW_STEP_REF_UNKNOWN: An invariant's stepRef points at a step id that doesn't exist in the same flow. Fix the stepRef value or add a `id: "..."` to the target step.
FLOW_DEPENDS_ON_UNKNOWN: A flow's dependsOn references a flow id that isn't defined anywhere in the loaded contract. Either fix the typo, or add the missing flow.
FLOW_CYCLE_DETECTED: Flows form a dependsOn cycle. Break it by removing the dependsOn edge that closes the cycle — usually the lower-level utility flow shouldn't depend on the higher-level test flow.
MISSING_BODY_RESOURCE_REF_PARENT_UNRESOL:
BUILDER + LEAD: the generator detected a Prisma FK on this endpoint's body but cannot locate which API endpoint creates the parent model. Two declarative fixes (either resolves it):

  (a) Builder: add @ResourceCaptures({ resource: '<lowercase-parent-model>', ... }) to the parent's POST endpoint. The generator uses x-resource-captures to map parent-model -> POST endpoint.

  (b) Builder: declare @BodyResourceRefs([{ parentField: '<field>', resource: '/<path>' }]) directly on this endpoint. Bypasses the parent-model lookup entirely.

Do NOT guess paths via /<base>s pluralization — that was the heuristic we removed. The mapping must be declared.
STATUS_REACH_404_BODY_FK_UNTYPED:
BUILDER: status-reach:404 emitter cannot determine a non-existent placeholder value for a body FK field because neither (a) the Zod schema declares `.uuid()` / `.email()` constraints, nor (b) the Prisma schema declares an @relation pairing the column with a parent model whose id type is known.

FIX (pick one):

  (a) Zod: add `.uuid()` or `.email()` to the field in the schema (in `packages/validation/schemas/`). The generator will then use ${uniqUuid} / ${uniqEmail}.

  (b) Prisma: add @relation(fields: [<fkField>], references: [id]) to pair the column with its parent model. The generator reads the parent model's id field type (String → ${uniqUuid}, Int → MIN_INT sentinel).

Do NOT default to a UUID — that's a heuristic that fails on Int-id codebases. Declare the type.
OVERRIDE_TRANSFORM_UNTYPED: GENERATOR: override transformer cannot determine a non-existent placeholder for the listed field — neither Zod format nor Prisma @relation provides the parent id type. Same fix as STATUS_REACH_404_BODY_FK_UNTYPED.
RESOURCE_GRAPH_NO_CREATE_ENDPOINT:
BUILDER or DERIVED-RESOURCE: a Prisma model has no POST endpoint declaring @ResourceCaptures({ resource: '<lowercase-model>' }). Two possible interpretations:

  (a) The model SHOULD have a POST endpoint and the controller is missing @ResourceCaptures. Add it.

  (b) The model is a DERIVED resource (auto-created by another endpoint, e.g. Activity records auto-emitted by Task/Comment mutations, or TeamMember created via team-invite flow). For derived resources, no separate POST endpoint exists and this diagnostic is informational. Chain emitters will not attempt to bootstrap this model directly — they'll thread through the parent that creates it.
RESOURCE_GRAPH_NO_ID_TYPE: PRISMA: model has no @id column. Add @id to the model's primary key field.
ROLE_REQUIREMENT_PARENT_FK_UNKNOWN: BUILDER: an endpoint declares @x-requires-parent-role but the named parentField is not a Prisma FK on this resource. Fix the field name in the extension OR add @relation in Prisma.
